Name: Novell ZENworks Configuration Management Preboot Service 0x06 Buffer Overflow
Description: This module exploits a remote buffer overflow in the ZENworks Configuration Management 10 SP2. The vulnerability exists in the Preboot service and can be triggered by sending a specially crafted packet with the opcode 0x06 (PROXY_CMD_CLEAR_WS) to the 998/TCP port. The module has been successfully tested on Novell ZENworks Configuration Management 10 SP2 and Windows Server 2003 SP2 (DEP bypass).
Targets: Novell ZENworks Configuration Management 10 SP2 / Windows 2003 SP2
